details: Case-insensitive search by vendor name or vendor code
Clear button (X icon) for quick search reset
Status filter: All / Active / Inactive (with vendor counts)
Grade filter: All / A / B / C / D / F
Clear Filters button when any filter is active
Sort by Vendor Code (A-Z and Z-A)
Sort by Performance Grade (Best First and Worst First)
Optimized for large vendor lists (tested up to 1000 items)
Dynamic vendor count with proper pluralization

technical_implementation.accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant with keyboard navigation
